Bash To Ash Terms of Use

Effective date: 14 October 2026

Developer: Rawan Alghamdi

Contact: bashtoash@gmail.com

These terms cover your use of Bash To Ash. A parent or guardian should review them if you are not old enough to enter an agreement where you live. You can read these terms offline in Settings > Support & privacy > Terms of use.

Playing the game

Apple's standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement applies to App Store distribution unless the developer provides a custom license for your country or region. You can read the standard agreement at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ (internet required). These app-specific Terms remain available offline.

You receive a personal, non-exclusive licence to play on devices you own or control for non-commercial entertainment, subject to these terms, applicable law and Apple's App Store terms. The game and its original content remain the property of their owners. Do not copy, redistribute or exploit them except where the law allows it.

Core play against bots does not require a purchase, linked account, rewarded ad or optional analytics. Combat tools in Standard and Fast are free. Characters, outfits, medals and arena choices are cosmetic and do not buy better character handling.

Coins and purchases

The Shop shows two separate balances:

• Device coins come from completed matches and free reward claims. They can buy cosmetic outfits on this device. The balance and ownership of these outfits stay on the device and are not included in Cloud backup. • Account coins include server-verified rewarded-ad earnings, eligible reward-card bonuses, gift and referral rewards, and Coins purchased through Apple. They and the ownership of outfits bought with them are stored with your game account. A guest can earn Account coins from ads; purchases require a linked, recoverable game account.

You cannot combine Device coins and Account coins to buy one outfit. The Shop identifies the balance used and lets you choose when both balances can cover the price. Account coin spending uses server-earned Account coins before purchased Coins and requires a connection. Neither kind of Coin nor any virtual item has cash value; they cannot be transferred to another person or exchanged for money or real-world goods.

Coin packs, reward-card packs and the First Flight pass use Apple in-app purchases. The Shop shows the product and Apple's localized price before you approve payment. Purchases use Apple's payment system and are delivered to the linked game account currently open. Do not buy again merely because delivery is delayed; use Restore purchases or contact support.

The First Flight pass is a one-time purchase with no automatic renewal or expiry. Its premium track contains ten cosmetic rewards: nine profile medals and the Dusk arena. Each tier requires three completed matches, so all ten unlock after 30 completed matches. Lifetime completed-match progress counts. The premium track does not award Coins. Free-track rewards remain available without the pass.

Link your game account before changing devices. Recovering the same linked account retrieves its Account coins and server-recorded ownership. Cloud backup separately restores supported looks and records; it does not recover Device coins or ownership of outfits bought with them. Restore purchases can recover verified non-consumable entitlements; it does not re-credit spent coin packs or consumed reward cards, or restore every piece of local progress. Cached, previously verified account entitlements let you equip supported owned cosmetics offline for up to 24 hours after the last verified refresh. Reconnect to verify and renew that access; this limit does not apply to Device coins or outfits bought with them. A connection is needed to verify new purchases and spend Account coins.

Apple handles refund requests. A refunded or revoked purchase can remove its associated entitlement or adjust the purchased portion of the Account coins wallet. Nothing in these terms limits mandatory consumer rights, including rights relating to faulty or misdescribed purchases.

Reward cards, gifts and referrals

Reward-doubler cards are consumable items, separate from rewarded videos. Review the exact bonus before confirming one card for one eligible completed match. You do not need to watch an ad or accept tracking to use a card. Declining to use a card leaves the earned base prize unchanged.

Earned cards can work offline and add Device coins. Their stock and claim journal remain on the device and are not restored by Cloud backup. Cards stored with your account, including purchased or gift cards, require a linked, recoverable account, a connection and a verified online result. They add an Account coins bonus only after service confirmation. An offline result cannot authorize a server reward. One match can receive only one card bonus. A prior refund adjustment can reduce the available account bonus; the confirmation shows the amount before a card is spent. Retrying a pending claim checks the same operation and does not use a second card.

Gift and referral rewards require a linked, recoverable account and service confirmation. A gift code can have an expiry and redemption limit and can be used once per account. A referral rewards a qualifying new accepted friendship after verification. The current offer grants 100 Account coins to each participant before refund adjustments, permits one invitee reward per account and up to ten referrer rewards per account, and expires the link after seven days. Sharing the game, opening a share sheet or inviting someone to a room does not by itself earn a referral reward. Do not create accounts or false friendships to bypass these limits. Gift codes grant the stated promotional reward; they do not transfer another player's wallet. Gift and referral Coin grants can first settle an outstanding refund adjustment; any remaining Coins are added to the available account balance. A successful claim is delivered once.

Rewarded ads

Rewarded ads are optional offers on Home. The offer states the action and exact reward before you choose to watch. Declining, skipping or having no ad available does not block normal play or remove earned match rewards. You do not need to click an ad, buy an advertised product or accept tracking permission to qualify.

Completing the stated viewing requirement earns the offered Account coins reward. Delivery may remain pending while confirmation or connectivity is delayed. The game delivers each verified reward once; reopening the app does not create a second reward. Report a missing reward through Support & privacy without buying anything or repeatedly watching ads. We are responsible for reward delivery; an ad provider does not endorse the game's rewards.

Accounts and online play

Accounts, cloud backups, friends, private rooms, public matching, Ranks, purchases, account rewards and ads need a connection for their online operations. Their availability depends on the relevant service being available. Keep access to your linked sign-in provider secure. Share room codes only with intended players. Do not cheat, forge purchases or rewards, use exploits, impersonate another account or disrupt other players or services. We may correct invalid rewards or leaderboard entries and restrict misuse, subject to applicable law.

You can decline requests, remove friends and block players. Your chosen public nickname and optional chosen country can appear in online features; a default or generated name is used if you have not chosen a nickname. Your private defender name is separate and remains on your device. Do not use a nickname to impersonate someone, harass others or publish offensive or private information. There is no free-form chat. Use REPORT PLAYER where available to submit a concern about an inappropriate nickname or player, or contact Support & privacy. Submit reports honestly. A receipt confirms that a report was stored, not that a moderation decision has been made. We may reject or suppress names or restrict accounts that violate these rules. Blocking a player helps prevent future public matching with them; it does not automatically end a match already in progress. The Privacy Policy explains what these features share.

When available, public matching is limited to the same league and a maximum 100-point rating gap across the group. Waiting does not relax those limits. Competitive rankings use verified public results; private matches and offline cumulative trophies do not increase competitive rating, wins or streaks. An initial rating is provisional, and unavailable verification does not become a verified match or reward.

You can start deletion in Settings > Account > Delete game account. Deletion removes account access and associated progress and wallet data, subject to the limited retention described in the Privacy Policy. It does not automatically refund purchases or delete your separate sign-in provider or Apple account. Review the confirmation before deleting.

Updates and support

Updates can fix problems and change future gameplay or rewards. We will describe material changes, and will not use these terms to remove mandatory consumer protections or misdescribe a purchased benefit. Online features can be interrupted, and some updates may be needed to keep using them. We do not promise uninterrupted or error-free operation.

You can stop using the game at any time. If a term cannot be enforced, the remaining terms continue to apply. Nothing here excludes liability or rights that applicable law does not allow to be excluded.

Contact Rawan Alghamdi at bashtoash@gmail.com. Help, privacy choices and contact actions are available in Settings > Support & privacy.

These documents are also available inside the app, including when you are offline.
